bias.en: Downtrend · broke $156, lowest close since April
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $156，收盘创 4月以来新低

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 15.3% on Nov 20 to $142.39, its lowest close since Apr 7, trading $140.69–163.51 on heavy volume (1.57x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($166.4), 10-day ($181.5), 30-day ($205.5) and 100-day ($229.9), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($223.9). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 17, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($206.43), and RSI is 32.4.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月20日下跌 15.3%，收于 $142.39，为 4月7日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $140.69–163.51，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.57 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$166.4）、10 日（$181.5）、30 日（$205.5）和 100 日均线（$229.9）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$223.9）。MACD 自 11月17日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$206.43），RSI 为 32.4。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $156–167 (Nov 5, 17 and 19 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $147.8 (November 2025 highs), then $156–157.3 (Jan 21 high, Nov 5 low) and $163–166.4 (Nov 20 high, 5-day). Support is $136–140.7 (Nov 20 and Jan 27 lows), then $131–132.5 (February and March lows) and $125.8. A close above $147.9 would target $156–157; below $136, $131–132.5.
